Production AI notes

What shipping AI actually teaches you

01HF rate-limit tiers

Quotas live server-side, or they don’t exist

Free previews are consumed with a row-locked UPDATE … WHERE used < 3 and fail closed — no session means unauthorized, never ok:true. Hugging Face runs the same playbook: anonymous buckets per IP on 5-minute windows, 429s with reset headers. Client-side counters are decoration.

02YC RFS: Proving You’re Human

Anonymous ≠ Sybil-open

Trials bind to the OS machine UID with highest-seen-wins across SQLite, keychain and localStorage, so reinstalls can’t reset the 3-query preview. YC’s current Requests for Startups literally asks for a trust layer proving you’re human — free tiers live or die on exactly this.

03HF routed vs custom-key

Route before you pay

hosted-auth / hosted-trial / BYOK / none is resolved before any provider work runs; BYOK skips credits entirely and trial spend happens once per user request, never on continuations. It mirrors Hugging Face billing: credits apply to routed calls only, custom keys bill the provider.

04YC agent red-teaming wave

Evals are the feature

A 184-test harness with routing truth tables and a blocked-telemetry error taxonomy (TrialExhausted, Suspended, HostedAuthRequired). YC’s newest agent startups sell exactly this — continuous red-teaming — because agents change behavior without code changing.
